author: b1ackfyre
body:
Rolled tacos and a bean & cheese burrito add potato and extra cheese from Pedro’s tacos (shit ton of Heinz sauce packets on the side).

I very much dislike everything else on the menu, the regular non-rolled tacos included. But those two things are my childhood.

author: GetTheLead_Out
body:
BCP is better than BCR

Back when Pedro's was cheap I used to get bean, cheese, potato, rice, add guac and it was a shocking $5 or something. Now you can't get shit for $5. Lol

This was also when I was young. And could manage that calorie bomb.
